column1: # Route-example parser sweep baseline (Task 2.7).
# One entry per line, three tab-separated columns:
#   path<TAB>fence_index<TAB>reason
# `path` is repo-relative; `fence_index` is the literal `file` for a whole file
# or the 0-based `yaml`/`yml`/`json` fence ordinal for a Markdown document.
# Lines starting with `#` are comments. `reason` is error text only, never a raw
# variable value.
# This 1 entry is a pre-existing job-document grammar mismatch, tracked in bd
# rc-fvkum. BareMap, WrongType, NonMutating, CreationError, Unresolved and
# complete routes this change owns are never listed here.
# The three `docs/src/components/ws-soap.md` entries and the other ten recorded
# entries were fixed and removed from this baseline.
# `docs/src/cli/job.md` fence 0 is a job document: valid per the `camel job`
# grammar (`crates/camel-cli/src/commands/job/document.rs`, which admits
# `description`), but the sweep validates fences with the route-DSL parser,
# which rejects the job-only `execute:`/`args:` envelope. No fence-side fix can
# keep the document truthful, so the entry stays until the sweep grows a
# job-document lens.
# `docs/src/components/opensearch.md` fence 0 is deliberately absent: it is the
# migrated B2 site from Task 1.4, its remaining pre-existing `set_header` map was
# repaired in the same change, and it classifies as Parsed.
# Fixed key-only scope (guard `baseline_entries_do_not_mask_change_owned_steps`):
# these entries cannot yield an isolatable step, so they are checked by key only.
# This is an explicit, fixed list, never a generic skip-on-error waiver:
#   docs/src/cli/job.md 0
docs/src/cli/job.md
